rationale: Class 2 review of both flagged rows. The filing schedule independently shows Grid Alliance Term Loan maturity 7/1/2032 and Blitz Term Loan maturity 5/2/2031, exactly matching the structured XBRL values and contradicting the dates embedded in the generated identifiers. The identifier maturity parser/extraction is therefore defective for both rows.
